import { chmodSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import { test } from "node:test";
test("runs a shell program written by the test", () => {
  writeFileSync(program, "#!/bin/sh\ncat\n");
  chmodSync(program, 0o755);
  spawnSync(program, { input: "x" });
});
test("runs a script program written by the test", () => {
  writeFileSync(program, "console.log('x')");
  chmodSync(program, 0o755);
  spawnSync(process.execPath, [program]);
});
